examples.text: sabb'ābhibhū sabbavidū'ham'asmi, sabbesu dhammesu anūpalitto, sabbañ'jaho taṇhakkhaye vimutto, sayaṃ abhiññāya kam'uddiseyyaṃ.

examples.text: pātimokkhe uddissamāne'ti uddisante vā uddisāpente vā sajjhāyaṃ vā karonte.

examples.text: uddhaccakukkuccaṭṭhāniyānaṃ, bhikkhave, dhammānaṃ manasikārabahulīkārā anuppannañ'c'eva uddhaccakukkuccaṃ uppajjati, uppannañ'ca uddhaccakukkuccaṃ bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya saṃvattati.

15180.meaning1: obstacle of restlessness and fidgetiness; hindrance of agitation and edginess

examples.text: caṅgavāran'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ nīvaraṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmacchandanīvaraṇassa, byāpādanīvaraṇassa, thīnamiddhanīvaraṇassa, uddhaccakukkuccanīvaraṇassa, vicikicchānīvaraṇassa.

15181.meaning1: obsessed by restlessness and fidgetiness; consumed by agitation and edginess

examples.text: uddhaccakukkucca-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so uddhaccakukkuccaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uddhaccakukkuccapariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu vicikicchāpariyuṭṭhito hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti. sace, bhikkhave, bhikkhu idhalokacintāya pasuto hoti, pariyuṭṭhitacitto'va hoti.

15182.meaning1: afflicted with restlessness and fidgetiness; overcome by agitation and edginess

examples.text: uddhaccakukkucca-pariyuṭṭhitena cetasā viharati uddhaccakukkuccaparetena uppannassa ca uddhaccakukkuccassa nissaraṇaṃ yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti. so uddhaccakukkuccaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

15183.meaning1: overcome by restlessness and fidgetiness; overpowered by agitation and edginess

examples.text: akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati. uddhaccakukkucc'ābhibhūtena, gahapati, cetasā viharanto akiccaṃ karoti, kiccaṃ aparādheti. akiccaṃ karonto kiccaṃ aparādhento yasā ca sukhā ca dhaṃsati.

15184.meaning1: closely associated with restlessness; connected with agitation
15184.commentary: (ADha) dvādasamassa samayavavatthāne uddhaccena sampayuttan'ti uddhaccasampayuttaṃ. (VISMa) aññesu akusalacittesu labbhamānam'pi uddhaccaṃ visesato etth'eva balavaṃ, tato eva sampayuttadhammesu padhānaṃ hutvā pavattatī'ti idam'eva uddhaccena visesetvā vuttaṃ uddhaccasampayuttan'ti.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando uddhaccasahagato uddhaccasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando.

15185.commentary: (SNa) uddhaccasahagato'ti idha bhikkhu chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikaronto nisīdati. ath'assa cittaṃ uddhacce patati. so buddhadhammasaṅghaguṇe āvajjetvā cittaṃ hāsetvā tosetvā kammaniyaṃ katvā puna chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karoti. ath'assa puna cittaṃ uddhacce patati.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando uddhaccasahagato uddhaccasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atippaggahito chando.
s'āhaṃ sugatassa sāvikā, magg'aṭṭh'aṅgikayānayāyinī, uddhaṭasallā anāsavā, suññ'āgāragatā ramām'ahaṃ.

nivāto nāma nīcamanatā nivātavuttitā, yāya samannāgato puggalo nihatamāno nihatadappo pādapuñchanakacoḷasadiso chinnavisāṇa-usabhasamo uddhaṭadāṭhasappasamo ca hutvā saṇho sakhilo sukhasambhāso hoti, ayaṃ nivāto.

15189.meaning1: who has pulled out the arrow; who has extracted the barb

examples.text: s'āhaṃ sugatassa sāvikā, magg'aṭṭh'aṅgikayānayāyinī, uddhaṭasallā anāsavā, suññ'āgāragatā ramām'ahaṃ.

15190.meaning1: arrogant; conceited; haughty; puffed up; overbearing; (comm) confused about what is right and wrong
15190.commentary: (SNa) uddhatā'ti akappiye kappiyasaññitāya ca kappiye akappiyasaññitāya ca anavajje sāvajjasaññitāya ca sāvajje anavajjasaññitāya ca uddhaccapakatikā hutvā.

examples.text: ye'me, bho gotama, puggalā assaddhā jīvik'atthā na saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitā saṭhā māyāvino ketabino uddhatā unnaḷā… na tehi bhavaṃ gotamo saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
ime pana dhammayog'amhā, dhammayog'amhā'ti uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatī asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākat'indriyā
kathābāhulle sati uddhaccaṃ, uddhatassa asaṃvaro, asaṃvutassa ārā cittaṃ samādhimhā
yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

15192.meaning1: due to the defilement of being agitated and having an unsettled mind

examples.text: ye kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā uddhatā avūpasantacittā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevanti, uddhata-avūpasantacitta-sandosahetu have te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā akusalaṃ bhayabheravaṃ avhāyanti.

15195.meaning1: feet upwards; with feet in the air

examples.text: icc'evaṃ vippalapantiṃ, phandamānaṃ tato tato, khipiṃsu niraye ghore, uddhapādaṃ avaṃsiraṃ.

15196.commentary: (ADht) iti uddham'adho tiriyan'ti eten'eva nayena uparimaṃ disaṃ, heṭṭhimaṃ disaṃ, anudisañ'ca anukkamena mettāsahagatena cetasā pharitvā viharatī'ti attho. ettāvatā ekam'ekaṃ disaṃ pariggahetvā odhiso mettāpharaṇataṃ dassitaṃ.

examples.text: dukkhavepakkaṃ yadatthi kammaṃ, uddham'adho tiriyaṃ vā'pi majjhe, paribbājayitvā pariññacārī, māyaṃ mānam'atho'pi lobhakodhaṃ, pariyantam'akāsi nāmarūpaṃ, taṃ paribbājakam'āhu pattipattan'ti.
iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.

15197.meaning1: above, below and across; in every direction
15197.meaning2: above, below and across; in every direction
15197.compound: dvanda (uddhaṃ ca adho ca tiriyaṃ ca)

examples.text: iti uddham'adhotiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ karuṇāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati. iti karuṇe'dhimutto'ti ahaṃ bhoto ājānāmi.

15198.commentary: (DNt) āghātanā uddhan'ti uddham'āghātanaṃ, maraṇato uddhaṃ pavatto attā'ti attho. uddham'āghātanan'ti pavatto vādo uddham'āghātano sahacaraṇavasena, taddhitavasena ca, antalopaniddeso vā esa.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddham'āghātanikā saññīvādā uddham'āghātanaṃ saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti soḷasahi vatthūhi.

15199.commentary: (DNa) uddham'āghātanikā'ti āghātanaṃ vuccati maraṇaṃ, uddham'āghātanā attānaṃ vadantī'ti uddham'āghātanikā. saññī'ti pavatto vādo, saññīvādo, so etesaṃ atthī'ti saññīvādā.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā uddham'āghātanikā saññīvādā uddham'āghātanaṃ saññiṃ attānaṃ paññapenti soḷasahi vatthūhi.
